title: Closing Apps Drains Your Battery Faster

scenes.name: The Compulsive Swipe
scenes.description: Duck furiously swiping open app cards away to save battery, battery indicator draining.

scenes.name: The Wolf Steps In
scenes.description: The Suited Wolf slides in, raises hand to stop the duck, smirk on reversal.

scenes.name: The CPU Drain Myth
scenes.description: App cards falsely labeled 'ACTIVE DRAIN', Duck looking panicked.

scenes.name: Frozen in RAM
scenes.description: Ice crystal freeze effect over background apps, drawing 0.002 mW.

scenes.name: The Cold Reload Spike
scenes.description: CPU load spikes to 100%, 1400 mW power surge from flash NAND reload.

scenes.name: Craig Federighi Verdict
scenes.description: Official Apple executive email verdict displayed on screen.

scenes.name: The Golden Rule
scenes.description: Wolf and Duck with full battery, calm OS memory management.
